title: Same Answer, Different Future: Matched Predictions Do Not Imply Matched Belief Updating in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.07913v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models can produce similar probabilistic predictions after observing outcomes, reading summaries, receiving instructions, or undergoing activation interventions. Whether these routes induce equivalent belief states remains unclear: agreement in current predictions does not establish how a model will respond to subsequent evidence. We investigate this distinction in a Bernoulli inference task with an analytic Bayesian reference. Across three open-weight language models, we prepare states through four textual routes and two activation-level interventions, measure both next-outcome continuations and explicit probabilistic estimates, and append identical new evidence from each prepared state. We quantify the persistence of the initial belief through its effective evidence weight, the number of new observations it is worth. We find that the format of evidence decides which readouts express its content: outcome sequences primarily aff

translated_title: 相同的答案，不同的未来：匹配的预测并不意味着语言模型中匹配的信念更新
translated_abstract: 语言模型在观察结果、阅读摘要、接收指令或经历激活干预后，可以产生相似的概率预测。然而这些途径是否会诱导出等价的信念状态仍不清楚：当前预测的一致性并不能说明模型将如何响应后续的证据。我们在一个具有解析贝叶斯参照的伯努利推断任务中研究了这一区别。在三个开源权重语言模型上，我们通过四种文本途径和两种激活层面的干预来准备模型状态，同时测量下一结果的续写与显式的概率估计，并从每个准备好的状态追加相同的新证据。我们通过有效证据权重（即初始信念等价于多少次新观察）来量化初始信念的持久性。我们发现，证据的格式决定了哪些读出（readout）能够表达其内容：结果序列主要影响……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现，语言模型通过不同途径（观察结果、摘要、指令或激活干预）即使得出相同的概率预测，其内部信念状态也并不等价，因而在面对后续相同新证据时会以不同的方式更新信念，即“当前预测一致”不代表“信念更新机制一致”。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that language models arriving at identical probabilistic predictions via different routes—outcome observation, summaries, instructions, or activation interventions—may hold non-equivalent internal belief states, leading to divergent belief updating when subsequent evidence is presented.
